Privacy and personal data

Test environment (REC) notice. It only applies to this access-restricted validation environment, which is separate from the public website and its own notice. It will be completed before commercial launch, including the legal identity and contact details of the data controller, currently awaiting official validation.

Contact form

In the test environment, requests are stored in a local SQLite database for functional validation. Use fictional data only. An internal notification may forward request contents to a controlled test mailbox via Resend. In REC, acknowledgements and status updates may be sent to explicitly authorised test addresses; other notifications remain in the test mailbox. You may also copy or download your request. Do not submit sensitive information or real customer data. For unsolicited applications, use fictitious details only and do not submit CVs or personal documents. Applications use the same local register, restricted to authorised administrators. Retention and data subject rights procedures must be validated before commercial launch.

Hosting

This version is intended for use in a test environment. Technical operations may involve separate data processing, particularly for access and security.

Service evolution

Before enabling a commercial contact form, the purposes, retention periods, recipients and procedures for exercising rights must be specified.
